changes.current_line: Online and in-store on one platform; the line between them has pretty much disappeared.
changes.change: For retail buyers who run the stores (COO, head of store operations), stop using the line and say 'One system for the tills and the website.' Follow it straight away with a live, step-by-step return of an online order at a store till. If live isn't possible, use a recording. Say 'the tills', not 'in-person payments' or 'point of sale'.
changes.why: The rep delivered M3 word for word and the head of store operations dismissed it with 'that's a diagram.' She then asked how a return works step by step at the till, which we described but never showed.

changes.change: For retail operations buyers, add an accountability line: 'One team owns your installs, your tills and your payments, so you never have two vendors pointing at each other.' Back it with the named people who run store rollouts. Only use this line once we can name who does the installs. Until then, do not claim it.
changes.why: The decider said 'I don't want two vendors pointing at each other.' Our answer to 'who does the installs' was a partner, while Adyen brought a retail team that had done store rollouts.

changes.current_line: Trusted by leading businesses; see our customer stories.
changes.change: For retail store buyers, replace 'see our customer stories' with an offer they can book: 'Talk to a retailer running our tills, and see a sample rollout plan with dates, who installs, and what happens to your old tills.' Only make this offer with a reference ready to schedule.
changes.why: The decider asked 'can I talk to them?' about our retail customer and we couldn't set up a call in time. Adyen named retailers she knew, and the customer also wanted a dated rollout plan.

changes.change: Add a retail opener aimed at the COO and head of stores rather than IT. Lead with the in-store return of an online order and loyalty that works in store and online, in their words: 'one customer, one basket.' Keep online checkout for the ecommerce lead, later in the conversation.
changes.why: The evaluation started at the till, where stores couldn't see online orders and store and web were two customer records. Our checkout demo only won over the ecommerce lead, while the COO made the call.
